responsibility: Declares the diagnostics::kind enum class generated from kinds.def and the basic kind-to-text/color query functions. This header is the typed public severity interface used across context, sinks, counters, and option classification to distinguish warnings, errors, notes, path events, promoted werrors, and related internal pseudo-kinds.
same_name_distinction: Unlike kinds.def, which is the raw X-macro table of diagnostic-kind entries, this header turns that table into the public enum class kind and declares the accessor functions used throughout the diagnostics subsystem.
